caseStudyHeader.heading: Content+ Offering Content Dashboard
caseStudyHeader.body: A dashboard for service offering teams that provides visibility into their offering's readiness and consultant usage.

summary.title: Goal
summary.description: The dashboard aimed to help service offering teams manage the lifecycle of their Offering and integrate them into a new content management system, Content+.

summary.title: Outcomes
summary.description: I delivered a high-fidelity prototype that articulated a new governance model and provided qualitative feedback for the first time.

summary.title: Role
summary.description: I owned the reporting dashboard and my biggest contribution was building out its interface.

summary.title: Client and scope
summary.description: The internal client for this project was a cross-functional team representing IBM Services and lasted 4 months in 2020.

context.statement: How might we design a better way for offering team members to maintain quality offering content?
list: Consultants needed fresh, calibrated content for client opportunities, but what offering teams provided was often outdated or inconsistently maintained.
Offering teams lacked centralized, sufficient data to understand how their content was actually being used.
Offering teams lacked the incentives and feedback loops to prioritize improving their content over time.
The vision was to extend how teams manage their offering's lifecycle -- tracking, strategizing, and evolving their content based on real feedback.
